entities.summary: Charles Leno Jr. is an American former professional football offensive tackle who played ten seasons in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Boise State Broncos and was selected by the Chicago Bears in the seventh round of the 2014 NFL draft. Leno was a seven-year starter for the Bears, making the 2019 Pro Bowl with them, and also played three seasons with the Washington Football Team / Commanders.
